component.name: Docket
component.summary: Plain-text task lists for Linux, TaskPaper format compatible

description.p: Docket is a native GTK4 editor for the TaskPaper file format: projects end with a colon, tasks start with a dash, notes are everything else, and @tags mark things up. Your files stay plain text that any editor can open; Docket makes them look, fold, and filter like an outliner.

The file is the database: every edit autosaves, there is no sync and no account, and the engine implements the full TaskPaper query language and date grammar behind it. Docket is an independent implementation and is not affiliated with Hog Bay Software.

screenshot.caption: A list with nested projects, the search-and-sidebar view showing projects, saved searches, and tags

description.p: The faithful editor. Outline behavior: folding with persisted fold state, smart enter, indent and moves, done toggling, paste re-parsing, and Archive Done. Live filtering with the full query language from the searchbar (Ctrl+F), a sidebar of projects, saved searches, and tags, inline tag completion, and the real application icon with a Flatpak manifest on the GNOME 50 runtime.

Initial release: the document engine (format, query language, dates), the editing window with continuous autosave and external-change reload, TaskPaper syntax presentation in Kanagawa Dragon, and the welcome document.
